messages:
Markus Klein: Kicking off coordination for weekly Standard Demo v1 dry runs. Goal: same flow every time, different persona emphasis per week. Need: (1) time that works NA + EMEA, (2) who’s in the room, (3) which persona each run targets. I’ll send a recurring invite once we lock.

Talia Benson: +1. Suggest we keep it 30 min hard stop, with 10 min for notes/action items. Also recommend we rotate “driver” vs “narrator” so AEs can practice.

Stephanie Nguyen: For NA, Tue/Wed 11:00–12:00 PT is generally ok. Please avoid Thu afternoons (forecast calls).

Lukas Meyer: For EMEA, anything after 18:00 CET gets rough. If we do 11:00 PT that’s 20:00 CET… doable sometimes but not weekly.

Soojin Lee: If we can do 9:00 PT / 18:00 CET that’s probably the least bad overlap. I can make that weekly.

Markus Klein: 9:00 PT / 18:00 CET works for me. Can we do Wednesdays?

Simran Kaur: Wed 9 PT works. I’d like to be on the first 2–3 runs to validate scenario order + expected outputs.

Renee Sullivan: Works. I can also keep a running “what broke / what to fix” doc and turn into runbook updates.

Colin O'Donnell: Wed 9 PT ok. If we’re showing tool calling + structured output, I want to be there for at least the first run to confirm scripts are the latest.

Camila Reyes: I can join every other week (messaging/proof points). If there’s a security-focused run, please tag me.

Markus Klein: Cool. Proposed recurring: Wed 9:00–9:30 PT / 18:00–18:30 CET. We’ll start next week.

Markus Klein: Draft schedule for persona targets (open to edits):
- Run #1: Platform Eng (reliability + routing/fallback + dashboards)
- Run #2: ML Eng (latency/cost controls, batching/caching, eval guardrails)
- Run #3: Security/Compliance (demo tenant isolation, logging/retention, SSO/RBAC story)
- Run #4: Procurement/Exec sponsor (deployment options, SLAs, upgrade path Hosted -> Dedicated/Private)
Repeat cycle.

Stephanie Nguyen: Love it. For Platform Eng run, can we make sure the “failure mode” is exercised (e.g., force fallback) so it doesn’t sound like theory.

Simran Kaur: Yes. We can do a controlled “primary route capacity constrained” simulation. I’ll prep a safe knob + exact steps so it’s deterministic.

Soojin Lee: For the Security run, I want to keep it super crisp: 10 min demo + 10 min FAQ + 10 min objection handling. Otherwise we’ll get sucked into a 45 min audit log rabbit hole.

Lukas Meyer: +1. Also for EMEA, please keep the EU routing/data residency line ready. Even if demo tenant is in US, we need the narrative for “how it would be set up.”

Markus Klein: Noted. We’ll add a short “EU-only routing is supported in Dedicated/Private with region pinning” slide/talk track for that run.

Talia Benson: Can we lock roles per run? Suggest:
- Driver (console clickpath)
- Narrator (talk track)
- Heckler (asks persona-specific questions)
- Scribe (captures issues)

Renee Sullivan: I can scribe consistently for the first month, then we can rotate.

Stephanie Nguyen: I can heckle for the procurement/exec run (pricing questions, “why not just use X” etc).

Camila Reyes: I’ll heckle on messaging/competitive angles for the Platform Eng run. I’ll keep it to the “what we show live vs what we claim” standard.

Colin O'Donnell: For Run #2 (ML Eng), I can drive the scripted API calls (curl + SDK) so we don’t fumble with terminals. Just need the final agreed command list.

Simran Kaur: I’ll be narrator for Run #1 to ensure flow is correct. Markus, you drive?

Markus Klein: Yep.

Markus Klein: Proposed attendees (keep it small):
Core:
- Markus (SE) – driver/narrator
- Soojin (PMM) – narrative/claims check
- Simran (scenarios) – scenario correctness
- Renee (enablement) – notes/runbook updates
Optional/rotating:
- Stephanie (VP Sales NA) – feedback + objection heckle
- Lukas (VP Sales EMEA) – EMEA persona + data residency objections
- Colin (integrations) – scripts sanity / demo tooling
- Camila (Marketing) – messaging/proof points

Stephanie Nguyen: Works. For sales leadership, we don’t need to be on every week; I’ll try to make #1 and #4 each cycle.

Lukas Meyer: Same. I’ll prioritize the security + procurement runs.

Soojin Lee: Please share the calendar invite with a consistent Zoom + a doc link where we drop the run notes. If there’s a recording, label it with persona + date.

Talia Benson: I’ll set up a recurring notes doc template + add agenda in the invite: “5 min setup check, 20 min run, 5 min action items.”

Markus Klein: Great. I’ll send the recurring invite today. Also: everyone please come with demo tenant access verified beforehand. Last week’s login issues cost us 10 min. :grimacing:

Renee Sullivan: Can we add a pre-run checklist line item: “dashboards load + model pinned + quota reset”? Even for internal.

Simran Kaur: +1 and for Run #1 we should practice the Plan B line if the model output varies. (How to narrate nondeterminism without sounding hand-wavy.)

Markus Klein: Yes. We’ll bake that into the script.

Talia Benson: Action items I captured:
1) Markus to send recurring invite (Wed 9 PT / 18 CET)
2) Talia to create notes template + link in invite
3) Simran to provide deterministic fallback steps + exact clickpath
4) Colin to provide final command list for ML Eng run
5) Soojin to outline Security run structure (demo/FAQ/objections)

Soojin Lee: Confirmed. I’ll drop a draft “security persona talk track” section before Run #3.

Colin O'Donnell: I’ll post the command list in thread once I validate against the current demo tenant.

Markus Klein: Perfect. See you all next Wed.
